name: A_TAG_TLP
description: Assign a TLP 2.0 marking via a deterministic keyword heuristic (design §4). Input: text, optional default_tlp. RED for active-incident language, AMBER for personal-data/credential mentions, GREEN for internal-community language, else default_tlp or TLP:CLEAR. Demo heuristic, not a sharing policy. Fully offline, no network ever.
